integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, the camera holds the exact final composition of the previous segment — a static close-up of Xiao Zhi's lips curving into a faint smirk beneath the red gauze soft scarf, warm candlelight on his gold hair crown — for two seconds. During this buffer he does not speak; his breath rises and falls once slowly, his weight shifts almost imperceptibly, his gaze holds — micro-movements, no dialogue. At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a wide shot of the wedding chamber at next morning's dawn — soft morning light enters through the lattice window, the red candles have burned out, a bowl of leftover congee and side dishes sits on the table. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the table where Xiao Zhi — black robe with gold dragon patterns, gold crown, jade hairpin, sword eyebrows, star-like eyes, thin lips, black belt with gold dragon buckle — sits upright holding a bowl, and Shen Jinghong — white and pale-gold woven-gold cross-collar ruqun with wide sleeves and layered wear, white satin long skirt, gold thin chain at waist, black center-parted hair with fine strands, peach-blossom eyes, pale pink lips, white jade teardrop earrings, gold tassel hairpins — stands to one side. [Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a medium two-shot across the table as Xiao Zhi gives one refined, contained cough, then steadies the medicine bowl in one hand; a low, composed male voice with cold authority, his own on-screen character voice (S3), says: <d>[Chinese] 王妃这汤药，怕是不太想让我喝。</d> Shen Jinghong sits opposite, her eyes tilting up with a faint smile; a clear, young female voice with a sharp, slightly playful timbre, her own on-screen character voice (S2), says: <d>[Chinese] 王爷既然'病入膏肓'，何不让正妃当家试试？</d> [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the soup bowl steaming, then to a close-up of Xiao Zhi's sleeve cuff revealing half a bandage — the sword-wound foreshadow — as he sets the bowl down; his own on-screen character voice (S3) says: <d>[Chinese] 那得看——王妃是否值得。</d> At 00:13.000 a calm, warm female narrator voice, off-screen, speaking at a steady pace (S1), says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 一个装病，一个装乖。这王府的天，才刚开始塌。</d> while both on-screen characters' lips remain completely closed. The camera holds a static medium shot of the two facing across the table as the segment ends.

overall_soundscape: The morning chamber carries a soft, airy resonance from the open lattice window, birdsong faint outside. The soup bowl emits a gentle steam-hiss. Porcelain clicks as Xiao Zhi sets the bowl down. Silk rustles as Shen Jinghong's wide sleeves shift. A refined, contained cough and the faint creak of the chair punctuate the tense quiet between lines.

non_diegetic_music: The previous segment's full ensemble recedes, then a guzheng joined by an erhu enters at a moderate tempo; the erhu's sustained bow weaves against the plucked guzheng in call-and-response phrases, the dynamic steady through the segment, neither rising nor fully releasing.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, an interior wide shot of a noble manor boudoir at dusk — warm orange sunset pours through carved lattice windows onto a polished wooden floor, a bronze mirror draped with red silk stands against the wall, and the room sinks into deepening twilight. The camera holds a static shot for two seconds, establishing the hushed, dimly golden bedroom, then pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the bed where Shen Jinghong — black long hair center-parted with fine strands falling naturally at her forehead, peach-blossom eyes, long eyelashes, pale pink lips, skin like congealed jade, white jade teardrop earrings, gold leaf-shaped tassel hairpins with pearl chains at the side of her hair, a light-blue thin ru jacket over a white skirt — lies reclined, her complexion faintly pale with a sheen of cold sweat on her brow, her breathing slow and even. [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot as Shen Wan'er — a woman of middling beauty with a pointed chin, phoenix eyes, heavy ornate makeup, a peach-red woven-gold ruqun, emerald earrings, and a red-gold hairpin — enters frame carrying a porcelain medicine bowl, her smile gentle and warm. A sweet, honeyed female voice with a hidden sharpness, her own on-screen character voice (S4), says: <d>[Chinese] 姐姐，娘亲又咳血了，您把这碗药喝了，好替她去庙里祈福。</d> Shen Jinghong — the same black center-parted hair, peach-blossom eyes, pale pink lips, white jade teardrop earrings, gold tassel hairpins, light-blue thin ru — hesitates, her gaze flickering with doubt, and a clear, young female voice with a sharp, slightly playful timbre, her own on-screen character voice (S2), says softly: <d>[Chinese] ……婉儿。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the medicine bowl approaching Shen Jinghong's lips, the porcelain glinting in the sunset light, then pulls to a close-up of Shen Wan'er stepping back one pace, her lips curling upward into a smug side profile, the warm window light raking across her face. A calm, warm female narrator voice, off-screen, speaking at a steady storytelling pace (S1), says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 嫡姐沈惊鸿，自幼聪慧过人。却被庶妹一碗迷药，灌进了她连面都没见过的花轿。</d> while Shen Jinghong's and Shen Wan'er's lips remain completely closed. The camera holds a static close-up on Shen Wan'er's smug side profile as the off-screen voice fades, her lips still curled, a faint weight shift in her stance — the final frame of the segment.

overall_soundscape: The hushed boudoir carries a soft, enclosed wooden-room reverberation. Silk rustles as Shen Wan'er's ruqun brushes against the bed frame. The porcelain medicine bowl emits a faint clink as it is lifted. Distant courtyard birdsong drifts through the open lattice window, muted by the deepening dusk. Shen Jinghong's slow breathing is barely audible against the stillness.

non_diegetic_music: A single guzheng note repeats in slow, restrained phrases, joined by a breathy xiao flute melody in a low register. The pattern opens independently at frame one and holds a slow tempo through the entire segment, the strings and flute thinning toward the end.

[Shot 2] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of her sleeve as a silver needle slides from within, the needle tip catching a single flash of light; her eyes narrow, pupils contracting. A clear, young female voice with a sharp, slightly playful timbre, her own on-screen character voice (S2), says to herself, almost a whisper: <d>[Chinese] ……沈婉儿，够狠。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:10.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot as a calm, warm female narrator voice, off-screen, speaking at a steady storytelling pace (S1), says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 替嫁冲喜，嫁的是那位传闻'活不过冬天'的病王。可庶妹不知道——</d> while Shen Jinghong's lips remain completely closed. Shen Jinghong's barely audible, controlled breath and the faint metallic whisper of the silver needle withdrawing from her sleeve punctuate the stillness.

non_diegetic_music: The xiao flute melody from the previous segment continues, but at roughly 00:03.000 a low-frequency drum pulse enters beneath the guzheng, accelerating the heartbeat-like suspense; the flute thins while the drum and a plucked guzheng motif build tension through the segment, the low pulse peaking toward the curtain-reveal ending.

At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a wide shot of the study at deep night — a single candle burns alone, moonlight and swaying bamboo shadows fall through the window.
